summary_en: Year-end dividend raised to ¥30/share (¥20 ordinary + ¥10 anniversary special) from prior forecast of ¥20. Interim dividend ¥20 unchanged. Full-year dividend ¥50/share vs. prior forecast ¥40/share. Anniversary special commemorates 35 years since founding in May 2026.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast (35th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: On 7 July 2026, Celsys Inc. announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending 31 December 2026. The interim dividend (second quarter) remains ¥20 per share. The year-end dividend has been raised to ¥30 per share, comprising ¥20 in ordinary dividend and ¥10 in 35th anniversary commemorative dividend. This revises the prior forecast announced on 5 June 2026 of ¥20 year-end dividend. Consequently, the full-year dividend increases to ¥50 per share from the previous forecast of ¥40 per share. The company states it recognises shareholder profit distribution as a key management priority and, while maintaining sound financial health, aims for continuous dividend growth with attention to return on equity (ROE). The company marked its 35th founding anniversary in May 2026, and the special dividend is intended to express gratitude to shareholders and stakeholders.
